1. [001] Mira Patel: Welcome to the Ember identity rollout checkpoint. We need final owners, but the conversation will include context and rejected ideas.
2. [002] Drew Singh: Older notes for the Ember workforce identity rollout are background only and must not be treated as assignments.
3. [003] Leah Kim: The dashboard contains a partial weekend and an internal test cohort, so its trend is descriptive.
4. [004] Oscar Reed: Yesterday's incident bridge is closed. Completed incident work is not a new action from this meeting.
5. [005] Ben Ito: It might be useful to add screenshots to the help-desk bulletin, but I am only suggesting it.
6. [006] Carmen Wells: A preference or suggestion remains outside the ledger until somebody makes a definite commitment.
7. [007] Mira Patel: I will publish the final rollback guide by 2026-10-05.
8. [008] Theo Grant: The rollback guide should identify the normal rollback boundary and the existing escalation room.
9. [009] Theo Grant: I will not rebuild the retired simulator, and that work has no owner.
10. [010] Leah Kim: I will reconcile the entitlement matrix with the approved scope by 2026-10-06.
11. [011] Drew Singh: Approved scope means the signed appendix, not the working spreadsheet attached to the calendar.
12. [012] Oscar Reed: I will configure the sign-in alert pack by 2026-10-07.
13. [013] Oscar Reed: The alert names need to preserve the current pager-search abbreviations.
14. [014] Nina Alvarez: I will approve the security exception by 2026-10-08 only if the independent retest is green; until then it is conditional.
15. [015] Carmen Wells: A green retest requires the signed assessment, not a chat message from the vendor.
16. [016] Ben Ito: I will draft the help-desk bulletin by 2026-10-07.
17. [017] Ben Ito: I can still answer terminology questions later even if delivery ownership changes.
18. [018] Theo Grant: I will package the tenant enablement build by 2026-10-09; this is blocked until the signing service is restored.
19. [019] Oscar Reed: The signing-service incident already has an owner outside this meeting, so do not create a duplicate task.
20. [020] Drew Singh: I will record the final go/no-go decision and distribute the signed decision record; there is no fixed due date.
21. [021] Carmen Wells: The recorded decision does not assign every idea discussed before it.
22. [022] Nina Alvarez: I will complete the launch-blocking privileged-role review by 2026-10-09.
23. [023] Mira Patel: Launch-blocking is explicit for that review, so it is critical rather than merely urgent.
24. [024] Oscar Reed: Service Operations will verify the overnight escalation roster by 2026-10-12.
25. [025] Oscar Reed: Service Operations is the canonical owner even if the individual on-call engineer changes.
26. [026] Ben Ito: I will schedule a broad training session by 2026-10-12.
27. [027] Leah Kim: The word Friday on the chart labels the sample window and is not an action due date.
28. [028] Oscar Reed: Correction: move my sign-in alert pack due date from 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-09; I remain the owner.
29. [029] Mira Patel: The corrected alert date supersedes the earlier date.
30. [030] Ben Ito: I withdraw the training-session commitment completely; omit it and assign no replacement.
31. [031] Carmen Wells: A possible training session next quarter does not revive the withdrawn commitment.
32. [032] Carmen Wells: Carmen Wells will own the help-desk bulletin instead of Ben Ito, keeping the due date 2026-10-07; Ben Ito is released.
33. [033] Ben Ito: Confirmed: I am released from delivery and remain available only for questions.
34. [034] Leah Kim: I will archive the reconciled evidence bundle by 2026-10-13.
35. [035] Leah Kim: That bundle is separate from the already archived prototype evidence.
36. [036] Drew Singh: We decided to keep one launch channel. This is a decision only; channel setup is not assigned.
37. [037] Ben Ito: I will publish the customer-blocking escalation matrix by 2026-10-12.
38. [038] Ben Ito: The escalation matrix is explicitly customer-blocking because support coverage is a launch prerequisite.
39. [039] Theo Grant: I can probably handle the fallback review soon, but I am not confirming ownership or a deadline.
40. [040] Mira Patel: Treat the fallback-review statement as ambiguity, not as an action item.
41. [041] Drew Singh: I will circulate the final ownership table by 2026-10-13.
42. [042] Carmen Wells: The ownership table must show the reassignment and exclude the withdrawn training session.
43. [043] Oscar Reed: Nobody should create a second pager rotation; the existing roster remains authoritative.
44. [044] Nina Alvarez: If the retest fails, the exception stays conditional and is not silently approved.
45. [045] Mira Patel: I will authorize tenant enablement only after the critical privileged-role review closes, with a target of 2026-10-13.
46. [046] Mira Patel: That authorization remains conditional even if the package arrives early.
47. [047] Drew Singh: The old prototype checklist was completed last month and appears here only as a distractor.
48. [048] Mira Patel: Final recap: retain explicit commitments with their latest owners, dates, conditions, and statuses.
49. [049] Drew Singh: This transcript is the complete experimental meeting record; side documents are not evidence.
50.
